title: Hex Trust Adds Custody Support for stETH via the Lido Protocol
summary: Hex Trust has introduced custody and staking support for stETH, Lido's liquid staking token.

title: Jerry of Ben & Jerry’s Resigns, Saying Company Has Been ‘Silenced’
summary: Jerry Greenfield said that the ice cream company, known for its activism, had been muzzled by Unilever, its parent company.

title: Federal Reserve to Meet Under Cloud of Trump’s Attacks
summary: Stephen Miran and Lisa Cook will both cast votes at the central bank’s meeting on Wednesday, where policymakers are expected to lower interest rates.
